name: smart-queue-root
description: QueueLess AI - Universal Smart Queue & Appointment System

scripts.build:pages: npm --prefix smart-queue/frontend run build && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force docs/assets, assets; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue docs/assets/*, assets/*; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force smart-queue/frontend/dist/* -Destination docs; Copy-Item -Force smart-queue/frontend/dist/index.html -Destination index.html; Copy-Item -Force smart-queue/frontend/dist/index.html -Destination 404.html; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force smart-queue/frontend/dist/assets/* -Destination assets"
scripts.test: npm run test:oauth && npm run test:portal && npm run test:booking && npm run test:step9 && npm run test:expiry && npm run test:queue-order && npm run test:backend-queue
